title: Dawnice 112kWh Commercial Energy Storage Case Study in Poland
summary: A 112kWh Dawnice outdoor cabinet paired with a 50kW Solis inverter, installed without taking up indoor floor space.
challenge: Poland's grid electricity prices pushed the client to look for self-sufficiency. The site needed to store daytime PV output, cut import during peak-tariff hours, and do it without surrendering floor space inside the building.
solution: A 112kWh outdoor-rated cabinet integrated with a 50kW Solis inverter. The PV array was mounted so that it also serves as the property boundary fence.
result: Stored PV is shifted into the evening and peak import is reduced, with the battery kept outdoors against the building wall.
